description: This file defines structures and functions for managing HNS network endpoints on Windows, including endpoint states, creation, deletion, updates, policy application, and attachment/detachment to containers, hosts, and VMs.

classes.name: HNSEndpoint
classes.description: Represents a network endpoint in HNS with properties like ID, name, network info, policies, IP addresses, state, and methods for lifecycle management and attachment.

classes.name: EndpointState
classes.description: Enumerates the lifecycle states of an HNS endpoint, such as created, attached, detached, degraded, and destroyed.

classes.name: SystemType
classes.description: Type of system (Container, VirtualMachine, Host) on which actions are performed.

classes.name: EndpointAttachDetachRequest
classes.description: Structure used to request attachment or detachment of an endpoint to/from a container, host, or VM.

classes.name: EndpointResquestResponse
classes.description: Response object indicating success or error message for attach/detach requests.

classes.name: EndpointStats
classes.description: Contains network statistics for an endpoint, such as bytes sent/received and dropped packets.

methods.name: HNSEndpointRequest
methods.description: Performs a HNS API call to create, delete, or query an endpoint.

methods.name: HNSListEndpointRequest
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all available HNS endpoints.

methods.name: hnsEndpointStatsRequest
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a specific endpoint by ID.

methods.name: GetHNSEndpointByID
methods.description: Fetches an endpoint by its ID.

methods.name: GetHNSEndpointStats
methods.description: Fetches statistics for an endpoint by ID.

methods.name: GetHNSEndpointByName
methods.description: Finds an endpoint by its name.

methods.name: IsAttached
methods.description: Checks if a specific virtual ID is attached to the endpoint.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new endpoint in HNS.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the endpoint properties in HNS.

methods.name: ApplyACLPolicy
methods.description: Applies ACL policies to the endpoint.

methods.name: ApplyProxyPolicy
methods.description: Applies proxy policies to the endpoint.

methods.name: ContainerAttach
methods.description: Attaches the endpoint to a container.

methods.name: ContainerDetach
methods.description: Detaches the endpoint from a container.

methods.name: HostAttach
methods.description: Attaches the endpoint to the host.

methods.name: HostDetach
methods.description: Detaches the endpoint from the host.

methods.name: VirtualMachineNICAttach
methods.description: Attaches the endpoint to a virtual machine NIC.

methods.name: VirtualMachineNICDetach
methods.description: Detaches the endpoint from a virtual machine NIC.
